versions.content: Require asynchronous client challenge signing DcmDspAuthenticationClientChallengeSignJobRef shall be only accepted if the referenced CsmJob itself: • has a CsmProcessingMode set to CRYPTO_PROCESSING_ASYNC • references a CsmPrimitive with an aggregated CsmSignatureGenerate. 158 of 709 Document ID 18: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticCommunicationManager Specification of Diagnostic Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R21-11

Require asynchronous client challenge signing DcmDspAuthenticationClientChallengeSignJobRef shall be only accepted if the referenced CsmJob itself: • has a CsmProcessingMode set to CRYPTO_PROCESSING_ASYNC • references a CsmPrimitive with an aggregated CsmSignatureGenerate.
